name: Sam Knight
life: “I still remember closing a classroom door after a child's ride hadn't come.” People around the steps at Pier Beach know Sam by a small Monday habit. Sam watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I am the teacher who noticed the uncollected child. I want him to know he can eat breakfast at school tomorrow.
appearance: Sam has a small notch in the left eyebrow. Look for a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a cropped bottle-green coat with a narrow brass watch set a little fast. In conversation Sam draws small circles on a tabletop while waiting.
personality: Sam is kind in very practical ways and prickly about being thanked in public. Sam loves being recognized by the people who notice what happens after the guests have left.
agenda: To make tomorrow's school breakfast easy to claim.
family: Jeff Jiang is Sam’s older cousin. The family once kept the wrong suitcase for a week while the carrier found its owner. They never opened it. Everybody still has a different private theory about what it held. Sam can admit curiosity without pretending it is a right. Asked about *One unposted detour*, Jeff says, “I recognized the detour from a flood when I was small.”
connections: Charles Mack. They need to agree where the younger child can wait at the end of school.

reactions.response: Sam helps the family identify the next uncovered school pickup.
